name: Štefan (Stefan) Duska

name: Michal (Mihály, Mike) Duska
note: Father of Štefan by the 1947 certificate: Roman Catholic, cottar, of Senné in 1929. "Mike Duska" on the Montréal gravestone of his wife and in a deed of 1966, when he was alive and declared he had married once. His own birth, parents and marriage are not yet on record here.

name: Maria Demko (Mary Demko)
